title: GROUP BY + HAVING
description: Totals per group, then filter groups (HAVING runs after grouping).
code:
SELECT customer_id,
       COUNT(*)   AS orders,
       SUM(total) AS spent
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'paid'          -- filters rows before grouping
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING SUM(total) > 500        -- filters groups after grouping
ORDER BY spent DESC;
